subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android completed chat messages support the full long-press action set proposed here: Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the final Android UX scope is a product choice and a maintainer-authored PR is already carrying one concrete direction.

options.title: Land the focused action menu
options.body: Proceed with the linked Android message-actions PR if review and device/emulator proof confirm Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply work across both chat surfaces.

options.title: Narrow to copy/select only
options.body: Ask the PR to ship only Copy and Select text now, leaving Share and Reply for a separate issue if maintainers want less product surface.

options.title: Defer the Android action surface
options.body: Keep the issue open but close or pause the linked PR if maintainers do not want message-level actions in the Android app yet.

recommendation.title: Land the focused action menu
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked Android message-actions PR if review and device/emulator proof confirm Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply work across both chat surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is assigned to this issue and authored the open same-repo PR that implements the proposed action set.
